title: Knapp and Corbell broke the Fravor Tic Tac story on radio before the New York Times

tellings.quote: is George Knapp and I did break the Commander Fravor story, the Tic Tac story. We did it quietly on the radio twice before the 2017 New York Times article.

plain: The filmmaker Jeremy Corbell says that he and the journalist George Knapp broke the story of David Fravor, a Navy fighter pilot who chased the Tic Tac (a white oval object shaped like the mint), on the radio, "quietly," twice before the New York Times published its article "Glowing Auras and 'Black Money': The Pentagon's Mysterious U.F.O. Program" on 16 December 2017. Corbell tells Michels this as one of the two who did it. If so, the story the Times made famous was already public on radio.
